metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: KODAK PROFESSIONAL PORTRA Films, Technical Data / Color Negative Film, KODAK Publication No. E-190, November 1998 (©Eastman Kodak Company, 1998; Minor Revision 11-98), PDF page 8 (spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves, minimum and midscale-neutral spectral density; no RMS granularity; Print Grain Index 30 for a 4x6 print from 135). PDF sha256 fa3e715bc7057e70a755a25b5535abf47a50ce868fe86e8b7c7732d51113cc23. Data (c) Eastman Kodak Company. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/kodak-e190/kodak_portra_160nc/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), steps 1-8: D-min removed, log E zero where green is 0.2 over D-min plus 3 stops, dye spectra reconstructed (dmid_dmin) from spektrafilm's generic_a dye set (Giorgianni, Madden & Kriss 2009, p. 112, via spektrafilm) because the datasheet gives no per-dye spectra, status-M unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, midscale alignment 'mid' (of none/green/mid, the lowest grey-ramp neutrality error, none 0.058, green 0.045, mid 0.044, among those whose kodak_portra_endura neutral filters fall in the shipped films' range), densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, and spektrafilm's grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 through kodak_portra_endura at data_trustability 0.3. hanatos2025 adaptation window [411.0, 27.3, 625.7, 64.2] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md.
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; target print kodak_portra_endura; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 0.2 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves in log10 H as printed; use 'still' and antihalation 'strong' as the shipped Kodak Portra 160 and 400 (spektrafilm).
Note: E-190 gives no RMS granularity, only a Print Grain Index (30 for a 4x6 print from 135, 4.4x; Kodak: not convertible to rms). The grain preset copies the shipped kodak_portra_160 (same speed; NC and VC differ by 3 PGI, under one just-noticeable step of 4).
